cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Grandad's embarrassed about the burnt gazebo. For his birthday speech, use 'Everyone's fine; we're celebrating indoors'. I'll help with the order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's already told Jean he set it on fire. She wants the full story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that opening. We can acknowledge the move without rehearsing his mistake for everyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked him to explain it before thanking her for the trifle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep our opening, then thank Jean. Leave the cause out; he doesn't need a second confession at his own party.
